Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Jay
Message:
feat(orgs/invest): rebuild as SOTA multi-asset investment division

Expands invest from a 3-role skeleton into a fully portable multi-asset
investment org: stocks (Alpaca paper) + crypto (24/7) + macro context
(FRED + yfinance read-only).

- 13 roles: 3 heads (research-director, risk-officer, execution-manager)
  + 10 specialists (signal/regime/news/filings/crypto/risk-analyst,
  position-sizer/trader/reporter/researcher)
- 13 skills: 8 baked into role prompts + 3 queryable by CTO
  (MULTI_ASSET_FUSION, OPTIONS_FLOW, CONTEXT_ENGINE_QUERY)
- 14 sandbox scripts: 10 migrated + 3 new (macro, crypto, alt_data) +
  fetch_data extended for multi-asset + trade.py keys moved to env
- Web MCP wired to 4 specialists (news/filings/crypto/researcher)
- 7 schedules incl. crypto_hourly (24/7) + macro_weekly (Sunday 7 PM)
- 3 modes: Lightning / Base / Conservative
- IaC: bootstrap.sh (idempotent via sha256), Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml

Verified: org audit passes (13 roles + 13 skills), bootstrap smoke test
exits 0, idempotent on rerun, live blockchain.info fetch works, alt_data
cache round-trips, multi-asset watchlist parses (7 stocks + 3 crypto +
6 macro tickers + 7 FRED series).
